description: This file defines a WebSocket-based real-time pub/sub hub for delivery notifications, including classes for subscription management and hub operations such as subscribe, unsubscribe, and publish.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Data class representing a subscription to a specific delivery_id using UUID.

classes.name: RealtimeHub
classes.description: In-memory pub/sub hub managing WebSocket subscriptions for delivery notifications, supporting subscribe, unsubscribe, and publish operations.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the RealtimeHub with an asyncio lock and a default dictionary for delivery subscriptions.

methods.name: None subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, delivery_id: UUID)
methods.description: Subscribes a WebSocket connection to a delivery ID, adding it to the set of subscribers for that delivery.

methods.name: None unsubscribe_all(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from all delivery subscriptions, cleaning up empty sets.

methods.name: None publish(self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Publishes a message to all WebSocket subscribers of a specific delivery ID, including message type and payload, timestamped with UTC time.

ctags.name: publish
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish(self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> No/
ctags.signature: (self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, delivery_id: UUID) -> None:$/

ctags.name: unsubscribe_all
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unsubscribe_all(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/
